title: Header SQLi to RCE with Out-of-Band Exfil
learning_objectives: Find SQL injection in an enterprise device-registration header (X-FCTUID) concatenated into an INSERT
Chain stacked queries into COPY ... TO PROGRAM command execution held by a superuser app role
Evade a naive keyword IPS that flags SELECT/UNION by using a table-source COPY (no SELECT in the payload)
Exfiltrate the result out-of-band to a controlled collector and retrieve it, rather than reading it in-band
Understand why an intended-RCE lab stays risk:low: no added caps, and the database is on a no-egress network so the only reachable listener is the in-lab collector
flag_hint: POST /device/register with an X-FCTUID header that stacks COPY ... TO PROGRAM to run a command reading the planted flag file and wget it to the in-lab collector (oob:9000). Read what the collector captured via GET /oob/received, then POST /solve {"flag":"FLAG{...}"}.
inspired_by: CVE-2023-48788 Fortinet FortiClient EMS SQLi to RCE (abstracted; no proprietary code reused)
